table assertion: | F32 | Entity-relative Behaviour execution and single-input serialisation | [DigitalTwin C19](component-register.md#c19) specialises Ponos; Behaviour [1..*], each through Praxis → Pathway → exactly one Ergo; Mneme manages Context/Pragma | One Stimulus/Effector queue; identifiable BehaviourStimulus/BehaviourEffector per interested Behaviour; sequential execution with fresh Context after predecessor completion/save on the normal path; open governed outputs | U02/U19 preserve A02 entity boundary. Developer sequencing policy through framework API; unspecified order without configuration. Applicable sequence stable for each input; changes apply to subsequent inputs. ContinueBehaviourOnFailure contains failure to the current execution, leaving the Behaviour active and other interested Behaviours and queue processing unaffected. StopBehaviourOnFailure stops the failing Behaviour immediately, lets remaining interested Behaviours complete the current input, then halts the Twin. StopDigitalTwinOnFailure terminates the failing Behaviour and halts the Twin immediately, preventing remaining current-input and subsequent queued processing. Queued inputs remain pending authorised Administrative Function/Ergon resume; stopped-Behaviour recovery deferred. Concurrency across independent Twins, no thread per Twin. [DesignNote](design-notes/DesignNote-Digital-Twin-Behaviour-and-Execution-Semantics.md); detail CDG-07/54/55. |
